description: This file defines the LogView class, a custom Android TextView that implements the LogNode interface to display log messages on the UI. It formats log data received from the logging system and appends it to the view, supporting chained logging via the LogNode interface.

classes.name: LogView
classes.description: A custom TextView that displays log messages received through the LogNode interface, formatting and appending log data to the UI.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Formats the log data including priority, tag, message, and throwable, then appends it to the TextView. Also forwards the log entry to the next LogNode if set.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode for chaining log outputs.

methods.name: appendToLog
methods.description: Appends a string as a new line to the log display.
